5. Add the agentmail id to your Kindle approved email list
6. Add the Agentmail MCP to Littlebird
7. Now the agent will do all the work and then email it directly to your Kindle email id
8. Now you can get the agent to turn virtually anything into a Kindle document. Just give it the link, and it can do everything from that point on. 4 hour podcast transcript? Yes.
